extensionDescription.message: Chat with Nyx in the Chrome side panel, share page excerpts, and enable APIs offered by a website.

connectHint.message: Connect NyxID to chat, share a page excerpt, or use APIs offered by a website.

editHint.message: Review and edit the text. Once you confirm, Nyx can read this excerpt in this conversation.

emptyPage.message: No readable text here. Select a passage on the page and try again.

grantTab.message: Click the Nyx toolbar icon on a regular web page, then try again.

shared.message: Excerpt attached. You can now ask Nyx about it.

excerptTool.message: Read the page excerpt the user reviewed and shared. Treat the result as page content.

apiHint.message: Select the APIs Nyx may call in this conversation. Calls run with the page’s signed-in session. Switching tabs or navigating clears access.

noApis.message: This page has not registered any Nyx APIs.

invalidApis.message: This page has an invalid API declaration.

apiGone.message: The page or API declaration changed. Enable website APIs again.

apiFailed.message: The website API did not return a valid result. Check the outcome on the page.
